claims.content: To register a new salesperson within the MSIU (VMU) system by capturing their user information and assigning them to a user group.

goal.raw_text: To register a new salesperson within the MSIU (VMU) system by capturing their user information and assigning them to a user group.

claims.content: VMU User
The system admin must be logged in, as only the system admin can create User Groups.
A User Group must already exist in the system for the salesperson to be assigned to (since 'Group Name' is selected from an existing User Group).
A VMU User (specifically the system admin) initiates the process to create a new individual user account for a salesperson.

trigger.raw_text: A VMU User (specifically the system admin) initiates the process to create a new individual user account for a salesperson.

claims.content: The system admin initiates the creation of a new individual user under an existing user group.
The system prompts for mandatory information including Group Name (selected from User Group), User Name, Password, and Verify Password.
The system admin enters the required user details.
The system validates that the Password and Verify Password values are equal.
The system checks that the User Name does not already exist in the system.
If all validations pass, the system saves the new user information.
If the 'Password' and 'Verify Password' values entered are not equal, the system does not save the user information.
If the 'User Name' provided already exists in the system, the system does not allow the creation of the individual user.
If the Password and Verify Password values entered by the user are not equal, the system does not save the user information.
If the User Name provided already exists in the system, the system does not allow the creation of the individual user.
The new individual user account for the MSIU Salesperson is saved in the system.
The new user is associated with a specific Group Name selected from an existing User Group.
The User Name of the registered salesperson is unique and does not duplicate any existing names in the system.
